scope: Thirteen CommonModule imports and finite actual template consumers after control-flow repair. No full native/AOT/packed/floor/G11 claim.

reviews.decision: In legacy-list/list-module.ts, CommonModule is a genuine public runtime value used exactly once in the owning MatLegacyListModule NgModule imports array. Checker resolution rejects type-only imports, missing/extra uses and shadowing. Complete authenticated Original16 and both advertised-minimum Common namespaces expose nondeprecated CommonModule, NgClass and NgTemplateOutlet; genuine public Core createNgModule/Injector factories instantiate the exact CommonModule class and execute its destruction hook on every line. The nine owned templates now use built-in control flow: every non-spec owned TS/HTML path is checked for retired NgIf/NgFor/NgSwitch uses. Exact pre-repair element/binding/event/reference/projection structures and all409 stylesheet bytes are preserved. Genuine public-peer JIT/template DOM and the actual private paginator directive pass265 observations with ten failing native controls, including item identity, duplicates/custom differs, projection and distinct SVG circles. Six templates previously matched the untouched tag byte-for-byte; the three preexisting accessibility/motion adaptations are retained with authenticated original diffs, not promoted to new historical expectations. This closes only the public CommonModule import and its finite template consumers. External Material/CDK components are protocols in the focused rendering suite; full owned component/module compilation, native layout, AOT, packed artifacts, runtime/compiler/RxJS floors and G11 remain unqualified. No required consumer HTML/CSS/SCSS edits.
